package.title: 5 Corners, 1 Random Rule, 1,000,000 Dots
alt_titles: Random Jumps Draw A Pentagon Of Pentagons
The Chaos Game On A Pentagon
description: The chaos game: pick one of a pentagon's 5 corners at random and jump 61.8% of the way to it (1/φ, the golden ratio). Repeat a million times.
The jumps are random, but the dots draw a perfect pentagon made of pentagons: a pentaflake, fractal dimension 1.672.
6 corners, jump 2/3 → a Sierpinski hexagon whose holes are edged with Koch snowflakes
3 corners, jump halfway → the Sierpinski triangle
Every dot here is a real jump, and every early pluck is one landing.
package.question: Did you expect pentagons inside pentagons? 👇
package.pinned: Jump 1/φ ≈ 0.618 of the way and the pentagons just touch. Any other ratio and they overlap or drift apart ⭐
